emma_ml: quick intake — can we prioritize bring-up and 4-bit quant experiments for falcon-refine-40b? need perf delta + any accuracy regressions.
raj: what exactly are we asking for? compute and timeline?
emma_ml: estimate 3 A100-80GB days for baseline + 2 days for quant sweep. target next-week prio review.
sofia: what's the user/product impact — which flow would this unlock?
emma_ml: retrieval-refine for search assistant. expected token throughput up ~20-30% with 4-bit, lower cost.
dylan: we should include hallucination + long-context evals, esp for refine loop.
cheng: infra: we can provision a dedicated node in qa-dedicated, need an INT ticket for allocation.
emma_ml: will open INT-4527 now. quick prioritization — reply with 1/2/3 per rubric below.
triage-bot: New intake created: INT-4527 (emma_ml)
sofia: 3 — high value, aligns with Q2 search improvements.
raj: 2 — signal is good but hold until eval regressions are clarified.
dylan: 3 if hallucination/QA suite included and we get metric baselines.
emma_ml: thanks. posting quick rubric for consistency:
```
1: low — exploratory, small infra, minimal product impact
2: medium — measurable perf/cost win, needs thorough evals
3: high — product SLA or critical path, requires fast-track
```
emma_ml: Action items:
- emma_ml: open INT-4527 with tags: quant, falcon-refine-40b, perf
- cheng: provision 3 A100-days on qa-dedicated
- dylan: add hallucination + long-context eval notebooks
- sofia/raj: confirm roadmap dependency and product owner sign-off
sofia: ack, I'll confirm product dependency by EOD.
cheng: provisioning request submitted to infra queue, expect node by tomorrow noon.
dylan: adding eval notebook and baseline scripts, will push to INT-4527.
emma_ml: if no regressions, target canary rollout in next-week prio block. :thumbsup:
raj: recommend canary plan: fallback to fp16 variant and auto-roll back on regression thresholds.
ema_ml: noted, drafting canary + rollback steps into the ticket.
triage-bot: INT-4527 updated: assignees=emma_ml,dylan,cheng
sofia: thanks team — holding for review in Monday prio slot.
